neighbours.label: 'question(s)' meaning an open research problem to be addressed (fundamental scientific questions, an original research question), not a question asked in class or on a quiz
fire: The project tackles open questions about how ice sheets melt.
Her thesis addresses a basic question in evolutionary biology.
The telescope will help answer key questions about early galaxies.
Ecologists still debate the question of why some species survive.
The grant funds research on unresolved questions in particle physics.
This study explores the question of how memory changes with age.
New tools let chemists address long-standing questions about catalysis.
The survey was designed to examine central questions in public health.
quiet: The quiz master read out the questions about famous rivers.
Her little brother asked a question about the dog's name.
The exam paper had twenty questions on the first page.
The waiter had a question about whether we wanted dessert.
Each round of the game show has five questions on sport.
During the interview she asked one question about the salary.
The form includes a question about your date of birth.
Several pupils raised their hands with questions about the homework.
